text:
maria: Need a one-pager + single-slide for enterprise buyers that clearly maps security, SLA, and deploy-mode choice. Deadline next Tue.

alana: Recommend a decision-first structure: 3 quick questions (compliance?, latency SLO?, cost sensitivity?) then recommended mode. Keep it skimmable.

vikram: Include a tiny benchmark row for credibility: Hosted p95 ~320ms | Dedicated p95 ~115ms | Private on-prem p95 ~170ms. Note caching reduces cost by ~30-50%.

nora: Sales wants 3 CTAs: "Request compliance brief", "Get SLA estimate", "Book a private trial". Also short email + webinar invite copy.

maria: Messaging options: 1) "Secure, SLA-backed inference for enterprise" 2) "Pick your SLA: hosted, reserved, or private" 99I prefer the second as it's action-oriented.

alana: Add a micro-diagram: axis of latency vs cost with callouts for compliance. Also a routing note: latency-first -> dedicated, cost-first -> hosted, compliance-first -> private.

ovs-b: (ops-bot) Suggested inbound tags: security, sla, private-trial, perf. Route security->AE+security-SEP; perf->perf-team. Template: https://internal/redwood/inbound-playbook

vikram: Small tech caveat: same weights across modes. Aggressive quantization may slightly affect outputs. Keep it 1 sentence.

maria: Webinar idea: "Operationalizing SLAs for LLMs" 30 min + 10 min Q&A. Use a short demo of routing/failover. nora can draft landing page.

nora: I'll draft the landing copy and two email templates (invite + follow up). Will include form fields: deploy mode interest, compliance checkbox, expected monthly requests.

maria: Asset list: 1-pager (nora), slide (design), benchmark PNG (vikram), routing playbook (ops), emails (nora). Preview Fri AM; final Mon EOD. Please ack.

alana: ack

vikram: ack - will upload bench PNG Mon

nora: ack - drafting tonight
